dict.string: IVY listens while you hold its shortcut so you can speak questions. Audio is transcribed locally on your Mac and never stored or uploaded.
IVY reads and creates reminders when you ask about your to-do list.
IVY reads, creates and completes reminders when you ask about your to-do list. Reminder data stays on your Mac.
IVY controls Spotify playback (play, pause, skip, volume) when you ask it to.
